item.title: From Appalachia to Africa: Why Dolly Parton was beloved across the continent
item.description: Dolly Parton's songs traveled far beyond Nashville. Across Africa, musicians embraced her stories of hardship, heartbreak and humble beginnings — and made them their own.

item.title: How America celebrated and mourned Dolly Parton, in Nashville and beyond
item.description:
The great Dolly Parton died earlier this week and tributes have poured in from across the country.

Fans are mourning the loss of a country music icon who not only changed the musical landscape but gave back to communities with her Imagination Library program and donations to develop the Moderna COVID vaccine.

item.title: Before an emergency hearing, the Kennedy Center's board threatens to demolish it
item.description: A lawsuit seeks to block President Trump's name from going back on the center. The center's board warns that if renovation plans don't go forward, it may be demolished.
